で動かした書き方です。@typescript/native は、npm に実在するパッケージ名ではなく、TypeScript 7 を入れるための別名の名前です。公式ブログと同じ名前を使いました。\n\n```\n{\n  \"devDependencies\": {\n    \"eslint\": \"^10.13.0\",\n    \"typescript\": \"npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2\",\n    \"typescript-eslint\": \"^8.72.0\",\n    \"vite\": \"^8.3.4\",\n    \"@typescript/native\": \"npm:typescript@^7.0.2\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\ntypescript という名前で で止まり、別名構成では通りました\n- ts-jest: そのままでは、API がないというエラーで失敗しました。別名構成では、preact-ts、solid-ts、react-ts で通り、vanilla-ts と lit-ts は雛形の verbatimModuleSyntax で別のエラーになりました。通った雛形は、ほぼ空の tsconfig.json を読んでおり、型検査の設定を通した結果ではありません\n- vue-tsc: そのままでは ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED で終了し、別名構成では通りました(.ts だけの検査です)\n- vitest: そのまま通りました\n\nそのほかの雛形です。\n\n- qwik-ts: TypeScript 7 の雛形ですが、@builder.io/qwik の peer が vite 8 未満で、--force なしでは npm install が止まります。--force で入れたあとは、ほかの 5 種と同じ結果でした。npm ci は測っていません\n- vue-ts と svelte-ts(TypeScript 6.0.3): typescript-eslint、ts-jest、vitest がそのまま通りました。typescript を 7   "content": "# React + TypeScript + Vite\n\nThis template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.\n\n## Tests\n\n```bash\nnpm test\nnpm run test:watch\n```\n\nCurrently, two official plugins are available:\n\n- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)\n- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)\n\n## React Compiler\n\nThe React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).\n\n## Expanding the ESLint configuration\n\nIf you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:\n\n```js\nexport default defineConfig([\n  globalIgnores(['dist']),\n  {\n    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],\n    extends: [\n      // Other configs...\n\n      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this\n      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,\n      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules\n      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,\n      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules\n      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,\n\n      // Other configs...\n    ],\n    languageOptions: {\n      parserOptions: {\n        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],\n        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,\n      },\n      // other options...\n    },\n  },\n])\n\n```\n\nYou can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:\n\n```js\n// eslint.config.js\nimport reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'\nimport reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'\n\nexport default defineConfig([\n  globalIgnores(['dist']),\n  {\n    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],\n    extends: [\n      // Other configs...\n      // Enable lint rules for React\n      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],\n      // Enable lint rules for React DOM\n      reactDom.configs.recommended,\n    ],\n    languageOptions: {\n      parserOptions: {\n        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],\n        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,\n      },\n      // other options...\n    },\n  },\n])\n\n```\n"

SEC stores them as parallel arrays (`form`, `filingDate`, `reportDate`, `accessionNumber`, `primaryDocument`, …).   "content": "---\nname: backend-nestjs\ndescription: Design, implement, review, and test modular NestJS TypeScript backend code using SOLID, DRY, dependency injection, clear responsibilities, and maintainable API boundaries. Use when working on backend modules, controllers, services, DTOs, providers, integrations, validation, errors, or tests.\n---\n\n# NestJS Backend Engineering Skill\n\n## Purpose\nBuild and maintain the SEC EDGAR filings backend in the existing NestJS project. Prefer simple, explicit, testable code over speculative abstractions. Follow the repository's established conventions unless they conflict with correctness, security, or maintainability.\n\n## Before changing code\n1. Inspect the relevant module, neighboring modules, package scripts, TypeScript configuration, lint rules, and tests.\n2. Identify the existing NestJS version and installed libraries. Do not upgrade or add dependencies without explaining the need and checking compatibility.\n3. State the files you intend to change and the responsibility of each change.\n4. Keep changes within the assignment scope. Do not create a database, authentication system, background jobs, caching infrastructure, or generic framework unless a requirement justifies it.\n5. If requirements or existing behavior are unclear, ask a focused question rather than guessing.\n\n## Architecture and module boundaries\n- Organize code by business capability, not by technical file type alone.\n- Keep each NestJS module cohesive and responsible for one capability, for example companies, filings, and SEC integration.\n- A module owns its controller, application/service logic, DTOs, domain types, and providers where appropriate.\n- Avoid circular module dependencies. If two modules need the same capability, extract a small well-named provider into an appropriate shared/integration module only when justified.\n- Keep `main.ts` focused on application bootstrap and global configuration.\n- Keep controllers thin: parse/validate input through DTOs and pipes, delegate to services, and map results to HTTP responses.\n- Services should have one clear reason to change. Split a service when it mixes unrelated responsibilities, but do not create a class for every trivial operation.\n- Keep SEC transport and response-shape handling behind an integration boundary. Do not leak raw SEC response objects into controllers or public API responses.\n- Define explicit public response contracts. Do not return arbitrary upstream payloads.\n\n## Module folder layout\nApply this layout to every backend feature module.\n\n- Keep `<module>.module.ts`, `<module>.controller.ts`, and `<module>.service.ts` at the module root when the module has one of each. A module with no HTTP routes, such as `sec`, has no controller.\n- Put DTOs and public interfaces in `dtos/`. Name DTO files `<name>.dto.ts`, for example `company.dto.ts`. Name interface files `<name>.interface.ts`.\n- Put unit tests in `__tests__/` and name them `<subject>.spec.ts`.\n- Put pipes in `pipes/` when a module has them. Use the same folder grouping for other repeated file kinds, such as `filters/` or `types/`.\n- Create a folder when that kind of file exists. Do not add empty folders. Leave a single file of its kind at the module root.\n- Keep SEC upstream payload types in `sec/types/`. Keep public API contracts in `dtos/`.\n- Keep end-to-end tests in `backend/test/` as `*.e2e-spec.ts`.\n\n## Central error handling\n- Keep shared errors and the HTTP exception filter under `common/` (`common/errors/`, `common/filters/`).\n- Do not add `*.errors.ts` inside feature modules (`companies`, `filings`, `sec`).\n- Feature code throws shared `AppError` (or Nest `HttpException` where it is already the right public response).\n- The global filter owns the JSON error body and status mapping. Register it in `configureApp` so bootstrap and e2e share it.\n

Inspect the relevant module, neighboring modules, package scripts, TypeScript configuration, lint rules, and tests.\n2. Identify the existing NestJS version and installed libraries. Do not upgrade or add dependencies without explaining the need and checking compatibility.\n3. State the files you intend to change and the responsibility of each change.\n4. Keep changes within the assignment scope. Do not create a database, authentication system, background jobs, caching infrastructure, or generic framework unless a requirement justifies it.\n5. If requirements or existing behavior are unclear, ask a focused question rather than guessing.\n\n## Architecture and module boundaries\n- Organize code by business capability, not by technical file type alone.\n- Keep each NestJS module cohesive and responsible for one capability, for example companies, filings, and SEC integration.\n- A module owns its controller, application/service logic, DTOs, domain types, and providers where appropriate.\n- Avoid circular module dependencies. If two modules need the same capability, extract a small well-named provider into an appropriate shared/integration module only when justified.\n- Keep `main.ts` focused on application bootstrap and global configuration.\n- Keep controllers thin: parse/validate input through DTOs and pipes, delegate to services, and map results to HTTP responses.\n- Services should have one clear reason to change. Split a service when it mixes unrelated responsibilities, but do not create a class for every trivial operation.\n- Keep SEC transport and response-shape handling behind an integration boundary. Do not leak raw SEC response objects into controllers or public API responses.\n- Define explicit public response contracts. Do not return arbitrary upstream payloads.\n\n## Module folder layout\nApply this layout to every backend feature module.\n\n- Keep `<module>.module.ts`, `<module>.controller.ts`, and `<module>.service.ts` at the module root when the module has one of each. A module with no HTTP routes, such as `sec`, has no controller.\n- Put DTOs and public interfaces in `dtos/`. Name DTO files `<name>.dto.ts`, for example `company.dto.ts`. Name interface files `<name>.interface.ts`.\n- Put unit tests in `__tests__/` and name them `<subject>.spec.ts`.\n- Put pipes in `pipes/` when a module has them. Use the same folder grouping for other repeated file kinds, such as `filters/` or `types/`.\n- Create a folder when that kind of file exists. Do not add empty folders. Leave a single file of its kind at the module root.\n- Keep SEC upstream payload types in `sec/types/`. Keep public API contracts in `dtos/`.\n- Keep end-to-end tests in `backend/test/` as `*.e2e-spec.ts`.\n\n## Central error handling\n- Keep shared errors and the HTTP exception filter under `common/` (`common/errors/`, `common/filters/`).\n- Do not add `*.errors.ts` inside feature modules (`companies`, `filings`, `sec`).\n- Feature code throws shared `AppError` (or Nest `HttpException` where it is already the right public response).\n- The global filter owns the JSON error body and status mapping. Register it in `configureApp` so bootstrap and e2e share it.\n

exception.stack : undefined,\n      );\n    }\n\n    response.status(body.statusCode).json(body);\n  }\n\n  private toErrorBody(exception: unknown): ErrorResponseBody {\n    if (exception instanceof AppError) {\n      return {\n        statusCode: APP_ERROR_STATUS[exception.code],\n        code: exception.code,\n        message: exception.message,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (exception instanceof HttpException) {\n      const statusCode = exception.getStatus();\n      const exceptionResponse = exception.getResponse();\n      const message =\n        typeof exceptionResponse === 'string'\n          ? exceptionResponse\n          : this.messageFromHttpResponse(exceptionResponse);\n\n      return {\n        statusCode,\n        code: this.codeFromStatus(statusCode),\n        message,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      statusCode: HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n      code: 'unavailable',\n      message: 'An unexpected error occurred.',\n    };\n  }\n\n  private messageFromHttpResponse(exceptionResponse: string | object): string {\n    if (\n      typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' &&\n      exceptionResponse !== null &&\n      'message' in exceptionResponse\n    ) {\n      const message = (exceptionResponse as { message: unknown }).message;\n      if (typeof message === 'string') {\n        return message;\n      }\n      if (Array.isArray(message)) {\n        return message.map(String).join(', ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    return 'Request failed.';\n  }\n\n  private codeFromStatus(statusCode: number): string {\n    switch (statusCode) {\n      case HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST:\n        return 'bad_request';\n      case HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND:\n        return 'not_found';\n      case HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN:\n        return 'forbidden';\n      case HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS:\n        return 'rate_limited';\n      case HttpStatus.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT:\n        return 'timeout';\n      case HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY:\n      case HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE:\n        return 'unavailable';\n      default:\n        return statusCode >= 500 ?   "content": "import { ArgumentsHost, HttpException, HttpStatus } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { AppError } from '../errors/app.error';\nimport { AppExceptionFilter } from '../filters/app-exception.filter';\n\ndescribe('AppExceptionFilter', () => {\n  const filter = new AppExceptionFilter();\n\n  function createHost(): {\n    host: ArgumentsHost;\n    status: jest.Mock;\n    json: jest.Mock;\n  } {\n    const json = jest.fn();\n    const status = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ json });\n    const host = {\n      switchToHttp: () => ({\n        getResponse: () => ({ status }),\n      }),\n    } as ArgumentsHost;\n\n    return { host, status, json };\n  }\n\n  it('maps AppError codes to HTTP status and body', () => {\n    const { host, status, json } = createHost();\n\n    filter.catch(new AppError('not_found', 'Company not found.'), host);\n\n    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);\n    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      statusCode: HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,\n      code: 'not_found',\n      message: 'Company not found.',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('maps Nest HttpException to the shared body shape', () => {\n    const { host, status, json } = createHost();\n\n    filter.catch(new HttpException('Bad input', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST), host);\n\n    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);\n    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      statusCode: HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,\n      code: 'bad_request',\n      message: 'Bad input',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('hides unexpected errors behind a generic message', () => {\n    const { host, status, json } = createHost();\n\n    filter.catch(new Error('secret stack detail'), host);\n\n    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR);\n    expect(json).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      statusCode: HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n      code: 'unavailable',\n      message: 'An unexpected error occurred.',\n    });\n  });\n});\n"

exception.stack : undefined,\n      );\n    }\n\n    response.status(body.statusCode).json(body);\n  }\n\n  private toErrorBody(exception: unknown): ErrorResponseBody {\n    if (exception instanceof AppError) {\n      return {\n        statusCode: APP_ERROR_STATUS[exception.code],\n        code: exception.code,\n        message: exception.message,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (exception instanceof HttpException) {\n      const statusCode = exception.getStatus();\n      const exceptionResponse = exception.getResponse();\n      const message =\n        typeof exceptionResponse === 'string'\n          ? exceptionResponse\n          : this.messageFromHttpResponse(exceptionResponse);\n\n      return {\n        statusCode,\n        code: this.codeFromStatus(statusCode),\n        message,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      statusCode: HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n      code: 'unavailable',\n      message: 'An unexpected error occurred.',\n    };\n  }\n\n  private messageFromHttpResponse(exceptionResponse: string | object): string {\n    if (\n      typeof exceptionResponse === 'object' &&\n      exceptionResponse !== null &&\n      'message' in exceptionResponse\n    ) {\n      const message = exceptionResponse.message;\n      if (typeof message === 'string') {\n        return message;\n      }\n      if (Array.isArray(message)) {\n        return message.map(String).join(', ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    return 'Request failed.';\n  }\n\n  private codeFromStatus(statusCode: number): string {\n    switch (statusCode) {\n      case HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST:\n        return 'bad_request';\n      case HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND:\n        return 'not_found';\n      case HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN:\n        return 'forbidden';\n      case HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS:\n        return 'rate_limited';\n      case HttpStatus.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT:\n        return 'timeout';\n      case HttpStatus.BAD_GATEWAY:\n      case HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE:\n        return 'unavailable';\n      default:\n        return statusCode >= 500 ? 'unavailable' : 'bad_request';\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

  "content": "import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';\n\nconst TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL = 'https://data.sec.gov';\nconst TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX = 'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data';\n\nexport interface SecConfig {\n  readonly dataBaseUrl: string;\n  readonly archivesBaseUrl: string;\n  readonly timeoutMs: number;\n  readonly minRequestIntervalMs: number;\n  readonly userAgent: string;\n}\n\nexport function loadSecConfig(config: ConfigService): SecConfig {\n  const userAgent = requireString(config, 'SEC_USER_AGENT');\n  if (/^https?:\\/\\//i.test(userAgent) || !userAgent.includes('@')) {\n    throw new Error(\n      'SEC_USER_AGENT must be a descriptive app name plus a contact email, not a bare URL.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  const dataBaseUrl = normalizeBaseUrl(\n    requireString(config, 'SEC_DATA_BASE_URL'),\n  );\n  if (dataBaseUrl !== TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `SEC_DATA_BASE_URL must be exactly ${TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const archivesBaseUrl = normalizeBaseUrl(\n    requireString(config, 'SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL'),\n  );\n  if (!archivesBaseUrl.startsWith(TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX)) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL must start with ${TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  return {\n    userAgent,\n    dataBaseUrl,\n    archivesBaseUrl,\n    timeoutMs: requirePositiveNumber(config, 'SEC_TIMEOUT_MS'),\n    minRequestIntervalMs: requirePositiveNumber(\n      config,\n      'SEC_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS',\n    ),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction requireString(config: ConfigService, key: string): string {\n  const value = config.get<string>(key)?.trim() ?? '';\n  if (!value) {\n    throw new Error(`${key} is required.`);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\nfunction requirePositiveNumber(config: ConfigService, key: string): number {\n  const raw = requireString(config, key);\n  const value = Number(raw);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {\n    throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive number.`);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\nfunction normalizeBaseUrl(url: string): string {\n  return url.replace(/\\/+$/, '');\n}\n"
}

Space SEC calls at 100ms. Require `SEC_USER_AGENT` with an email contact.\nRejected: Per-module `*.errors.ts`, `@nestjs/config` 12, `@nestjs/axios`, `npm audit fix --force`, and inventing a real contact email.\nWhy: One error shape for later modules.   "content": "import { AppError } from '../../common/errors/app.error';\nimport { normalizeCik, stripLeadingZeros } from './sec-identifiers';\n\nexport function buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n  archivesBaseUrl: string,\n  cik: string,\n  accessionNumber: string,\n  primaryDocument: string,\n): string {\n  const cikForPath = stripLeadingZeros(normalizeCik(cik));\n  const accessionPath = accessionNumber.replace(/-/g, '');\n  const document = primaryDocument.replace(/^\\/+/, '');\n\n  if (!cikForPath || !accessionPath || !document) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_request',\n      'Cannot build SEC document URL from incomplete identifiers.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  return `${archivesBaseUrl}/${cikForPath}/${accessionPath}/${document}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Historical submission files do not always repeat CIK. Derive the numeric\n * CIK prefix from the accession number (CIK-year-sequence).\n */\nexport function buildPrimaryDocumentUrlFromAccession(\n  archivesBaseUrl: string,\n  accessionNumber: string,\n  primaryDocument: string,\n): string {\n  const cikPrefix = accessionNumber.split('-')[0];\n  if (!cikPrefix) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_response',\n      'SEC accession number is missing a CIK prefix.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  return buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n    archivesBaseUrl,\n    cikPrefix,\n    accessionNumber,\n    primaryDocument,\n  );\n}\n"
}

Check SEC_USER_AGENT.',\n      );\n    case 429:\n      return new AppError(\n        'rate_limited',\n        'SEC rate limit exceeded. Retry later.',\n      );\n    default:\n      break;\n  }\n\n  if (status !== undefined && status >= 500) {\n    return new AppError('unavailable', 'SEC service is unavailable.');\n  }\n\n  return new AppError('unavailable', 'SEC request failed.');\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport type { AxiosInstance } from 'axios';\nimport { AppError } from '../common/errors/app.error';\nimport type { SecCompanySubmissions } from './dtos/sec-company.interface';\nimport type { SecFilingRecord } from './dtos/sec-filing.interface';\nimport { mapSecAxiosError } from './http/map-sec-axios-error';\nimport {\n  mapCompany,\n  mapFilingArrays,\n  mapHistoricalFiles,\n} from './mappers/sec-submissions.mapper';\nimport type { SecConfig } from './sec.config';\nimport { SEC_AXIOS, SEC_CONFIG } from './sec.constants';\nimport type {\n  SecHistoricalFilingsResponse,\n  SecSubmissionsResponse,\n} from './types/sec-submissions.type';\nimport { buildPrimaryDocumentUrl } from './utils/sec-document-url';\nimport {\n  isSafeSubmissionsFileName,\n  normalizeCik,\n} from './utils/sec-identifiers';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class SecClient {\n  private lastRequestAt = 0;\n  private requestQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();\n\n  constructor(\n    @Inject(SEC_AXIOS) private readonly http: AxiosInstance,\n    @Inject(SEC_CONFIG) private readonly config: SecConfig,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getCompanySubmissions(cik: string): Promise<SecCompanySubmissions> {\n    const paddedCik = normalizeCik(cik);\n    const data = await this.getJson<SecSubmissionsResponse>(\n      `/submissions/CIK${paddedCik}.json`,\n    );\n\n    const company = mapCompany(data, paddedCik);\n    const recent = data.filings?.recent;\n    if (!recent) {\n      throw new AppError(\n        'bad_response',\n        'SEC submissions response is missing recent filings.',\n      );\n    }\n\n    const recentFilings = mapFilingArrays(\n      this.config.archivesBaseUrl,\n      recent,\n      company.cik,\n    );\n    const historicalFiles = mapHistoricalFiles(data.filings?.files ?? []);\n\n    return {\n      company,\n      recentFilings,\n      historicalFiles,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getSubmissionsFile(fileName: string): Promise<SecFilingRecord[]> {\n    if (!isSafeSubmissionsFileName(fileName)) {\n      throw new AppError('bad_request', 'Invalid SEC submissions file name.');\n    }\n\n    const data = await this.getJson<SecHistoricalFilingsResponse>(\n      `/submissions/${fileName}`,\n    );\n\n    return mapFilingArrays(this.config.archivesBaseUrl, data, '');\n  }\n\n  buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n    cik: string,\n    accessionNumber: string,\n    primaryDocument: string,\n  ): string {\n    return buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n      this.config.archivesBaseUrl,\n      cik,\n      accessionNumber,\n      primaryDocument,\n    );\n  }\n\n  private async getJson<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {\n    await this.scheduleRequest();\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.http.get<T>(path);\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      throw mapSecAxiosError(error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private scheduleRequest(): Promise<void> {\n    const run = this.requestQueue.then(async () => {\n      const waitMs = Math.max(\n        0,\n        this.config.minRequestIntervalMs - (Date.now() - this.lastRequestAt),\n      );\n      if (waitMs > 0) {\n        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitMs));\n      }\n      this.lastRequestAt = Date.now();\n    });\n\n    this.requestQueue = run.catch(() => undefined);\n    return run;\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "## 2026-11-14T12:46+01:00\nDecision: Pin glob to 14.0.6, and the typescript-eslint and test-exclude copies of minimatch to 11.0.8, with npm overrides.\nRejected: `npm audit fix --force`, and a global minimatch override.\nWhy: Force would downgrade Jest 30 to 25. A global minimatch pin would replace ESLint's minimatch 3. deepmerge 4.3.1 has no patched release, so those lows stay; Jest only uses it to merge local config.\n\n## 2026-11-14T13:45+01:00\nDecision: Scaffold `frontend/` with Vite 8, React 19, ESLint 10, TypeScript 6.0.3, and Vitest 5. Pin `@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree`'s minimatch to 11.0.8.\nRejected: Oxlint, TypeScript 7, and `npm audit fix --force`.\nWhy: `typescript-eslint` 8.72 does not support TypeScript 7. The first audit reported 7 moderate findings, all minimatch 10.2.6 under typescript-eslint (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249). The suggested fix downgrades typescript-eslint to 8.36.0. After the scoped override, `npm audit` reports 0 vulnerabilities. Vitest 5.1 and jsdom 31 skip Node 25 in their engines; tests, lint, and build still passed on Node 25.9.0.\n\n## 2026-11-15T20:06+01:00\nDecision: Install `@nestjs/swagger` 11.4.8. Serve controller routes under `/api`, and mount Swagger UI at `/docs` with the OpenAPI JSON at `/docs-json`. Share that setup through `configureApp` so bootstrap and e2e use the same paths.\nRejected: `@nestjs/swagger` 12, mounting Swagger at `/api`, `useGlobalPrefix`, `addServer('/api')`, and `npm audit fix --force`.\nWhy: NestJS is 11.2.10, and Swagger 12 peers on Nest 12. A Swagger path of `api` would occupy `GET /api`. Spec paths already include the prefix, so an extra server URL would call `/api/api/...`. Backend `npm audit` reports 6 low findings, all deepmerge via Jest (GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4). Force would install Jest 25.1.0.\n\n## 2026-11-15T20:45+01:00\nDecision: Add `sec` with a shared axios `SecClient`, central `common/errors` + `AppExceptionFilter`, `@nestjs/config` 4.0.4, and `axios` 1.21.1. Space SEC calls at 100ms. Require `SEC_USER_AGENT` with an email contact.\nRejected: Per-module `*.errors.ts`, `@nestjs/config` 12, `@nestjs/axios`, `npm audit fix --force`, and inventing a real contact email.\nWhy: One error shape for later modules. Config 12 peers on Nest 12. Plain axios matches the plan. Audit still shows 6 low deepmerge findings via Jest only.\n\n## 2026-11-15T21:29+01:00\nDecision: Load SEC URLs, timeout, and request spacing from `.env` through `loadSecConfig` / `SEC_CONFIG`. Keep only DI tokens in `sec.constants.ts`.\nRejected: A shared `common` axios instance, and leaving Archives URL / interval hardcoded in `SecClient`.\nWhy: Deploy-time SEC settings belong in env. Axios stays SEC-scoped so fair-access headers do not leak to other callers.\n\n## 2026-11-15T21:41+01:00\nDecision: Split `SecClient` into pure `mappers/`, `utils/`, and `sec/http/map-sec-axios-error.ts` helpers; keep `SecClient` as the Nest orchestrator.\nRejected: Moving axios error mapping into `common/errors`, and registering helpers as Nest providers.\nWhy: SEC transport mapping stays in `sec`. Pure functions stay easy to unit-test without DI.\n"

  "content": "import type { SecFilingRecord } from '../../sec/dtos/sec-filing.interface';\nimport type { ListFilingsQueryDto } from '../dtos/list-filings-query.dto';\n\nexport function oldestFilingDate(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): string | undefined {\n  if (filings.length === 0) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  let oldest = filings[0]?.filingDate;\n  if (!oldest) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  for (const filing of filings) {\n    if (filing.filingDate < oldest) {\n      oldest = filing.filingDate;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return oldest;\n}\n\nexport function mergeByAccession(\n  primary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  secondary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const byAccession = new Map<string, SecFilingRecord>();\n  for (const filing of [...primary, ...secondary]) {\n    byAccession.set(filing.accessionNumber, filing);\n  }\n  return [...byAccession.values()];\n}\n\nexport function filterFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  query: Pick<ListFilingsQueryDto, 'formType' | 'startDate' | 'endDate'>,\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const formType = query.formType?.trim();\n\n  return filings.filter((filing) => {\n    if (formType && filing.formType !== formType) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.startDate && filing.filingDate < query.startDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.endDate && filing.filingDate > query.endDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n  });\n}\n\nexport function sortFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  return [...filings].sort((left, right) => {\n    if (left.filingDate !== right.filingDate) {\n      return right.filingDate.localeCompare(left.filingDate);\n    }\n    return right.accessionNumber.localeCompare(left.accessionNumber);\n  });\n}\n\nexport function paginateFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  page: number,\n  limit: number,\n): {\n  data: SecFilingRecord[];\n  total: number;\n  totalPages: number;\n} {\n  const total = filings.length;\n  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);\n  const start = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n  return {\n    data: filings.slice(start, start + limit),\n    total,\n    totalPages,\n  };\n}\n"
}

selectOverlappingHistoricalFiles } from './utils/historical-files';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FilingsService {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly companiesService: CompaniesService,\n    private readonly secClient: SecClient,\n  ) {}\n\n  async list(\n    ticker: string,\n    query: ListFilingsQueryDto,\n  ): Promise<PaginatedFilingsDto> {\n    assertDateRange(query.startDate, query.endDate);\n\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const submissions = await this.secClient.getCompanySubmissions(company.cik);\n\n    let filings =   data: page.data.map((filing) => toFilingDto(filing)),\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n      total: page.total,\n      totalPages: page.totalPages,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async findByAccession(\n    ticker: string,\n    accessionNumber: string,\n  ): Promise<FilingDto> {\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const normalizedAccession = filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n    );\n    if (fromRecent) {\n      return toFilingDto(fromRecent);\n    }\n\n    for (const file of submissions.historicalFiles) {\n      const historical = await this.secClient.getSubmissionsFile(file.name);\n      const match = historical.find(\n        (filing) => filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n      );\n      if (match) {\n        return toFilingDto(match);\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new AppError(\n      'not_found',\n      `Filing \"${normalizedAccession}\" was not found for ${company.ticker}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  private async loadHistoricalFilings(\n    files: readonly SecSubmissionsFileRef[],\n    startDate: string,\n    endDate?: string,\n  ): Promise<SecFilingRecord[]> {\n    const overlapping =   "content": "import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from '@nestjs/swagger';\nimport { AppExceptionFilter } from './common/filters/app-exception.filter';\n\nexport function configureApp(app: INestApplication): void {\n  app.setGlobalPrefix('api', {\n    exclude: ['health'],\n  });\n  app.enableCors({\n    origin: ['http://localhost:5173'],\n  });\n  app.useGlobalPipes(\n    new ValidationPipe({\n      transform: true,\n      whitelist: true,\n      forbidNonWhitelisted: true,\n      transformOptions: {\n        enableImplicitConversion: true,\n        exposeDefaultValues: true,\n      },\n    }),\n  );\n  app.useGlobalFilters(new AppExceptionFilter());\n\n  const config = new DocumentBuilder()\n    .setTitle('SEC EDGAR filings')\n    .setDescription('Read-only filings API for the supported tickers.')\n    .setVersion('1.0')\n    .build();\n\n  SwaggerModule.setup('docs', app, () =>\n    SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config),\n  );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { SecFilingRecord } from '../../sec/dtos/sec-filing.interface';\nimport type { ListFilingsQueryDto } from '../dtos/list-filings-query.dto';\n\nexport function oldestFilingDate(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): string | undefined {\n  if (filings.length === 0) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  let oldest = filings[0]?.filingDate;\n  if (!oldest) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  for (const filing of filings) {\n    if (filing.filingDate < oldest) {\n      oldest = filing.filingDate;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return oldest;\n}\n\nexport function mergeByAccession(\n  primary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  secondary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const byAccession = new Map<string, SecFilingRecord>();\n  for (const filing of [...primary, ...secondary]) {\n    byAccession.set(filing.accessionNumber, filing);\n  }\n  return [...byAccession.values()];\n}\n\nexport function filterFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  query: Pick<ListFilingsQueryDto, 'formType' | 'startDate' | 'endDate'>,\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const formType = query.formType?.trim().toUpperCase();\n\n  return filings.filter((filing) => {\n    if (formType && filing.formType.trim().toUpperCase() !== formType) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.startDate && filing.filingDate < query.startDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.endDate && filing.filingDate > query.endDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n  });\n}\n\nexport function sortFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  return [...filings].sort((left, right) => {\n    if (left.filingDate !== right.filingDate) {\n      return right.filingDate.localeCompare(left.filingDate);\n    }\n    return right.accessionNumber.localeCompare(left.accessionNumber);\n  });\n}\n\nexport function paginateFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  page: number,\n  limit: number,\n): {\n  data: SecFilingRecord[];\n  total: number;\n  totalPages: number;\n} {\n  const total = filings.length;\n  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);\n  const start = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n  return {\n    data: filings.slice(start, start + limit),\n    total,\n    totalPages,\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ApiOkResponse, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';\nimport { AppService } from './app.service';\nimport type { HealthDto } from './app.service';\n\n@ApiTags('health')\n@Controller('health')\nexport class AppController {\n  constructor(private readonly appService: AppService) {}\n\n  @Get()\n  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Health check with app version and current time' })\n  @ApiOkResponse({\n    schema: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        version: { type: 'string', example: '0.0.1' },\n        datetime: {\n          type: 'string',\n          example: '2026-11-15T21:40:00.000Z',\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  })\n  getHealth(): HealthDto {\n    return this.appService.getHealth();\n  }\n}\n"

}

  "content": "import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'\n\ntype FilingsPaginationProps = {\n  page: number\n  totalPages: number\n  total: number\n  onPageChange: (page: number) => void\n  disabled?: boolean\n}\n\nexport function FilingsPagination({\n  page,\n  totalPages,\n  total,\n  onPageChange,\n  disabled = false,\n}: FilingsPaginationProps) {\n  if (totalPages <= 0) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex w-full flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">\n        Page {page} of {totalPages} · {total} filing{total === 1 ? '' : 's'}\n      </p>\n      <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n        <Button\n          type=\"button\"\n          variant=\"outline\"\n          size=\"sm\"\n          disabled={disabled || page <= 1}\n          onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}\n        >\n          Previous\n        </Button>\n        <Button\n          type=\"button\"\n          variant=\"outline\"\n          size=\"sm\"\n          disabled={disabled || page >= totalPages}\n          onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}\n        >\n          Next\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"
}

  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/README.md",
  "content": "# SEC EDGAR Filings Explorer\n\nRead-only app for browsing SEC EDGAR filings for six supported companies: **AAPL**, **META**, **GOOGL**, **AMZN**, **NFLX**, and **GS**.\n\nThe React frontend talks only to the NestJS backend. The backend is the only service that calls SEC EDGAR.\n\nMore detail:\n\n- Backend: [`backend/README.md`](backend/README.md)\n- Frontend: [`frontend/README.md`](frontend/README.md)\n\n## Tech stack\n\n| Layer | Technologies |\n| --- | --- |\n| Backend | NestJS 11, TypeScript, `@nestjs/config`, Axios (SEC client), class-validator, Swagger |\n| Frontend | React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Axios, React Hook Form, Zod, React Router, Lucide |\n\n## Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository.\n2. Install dependencies for each app (there is no root `package.json`):\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm install\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm install\n```\n\nUse a current Node.js LTS release (or compatible modern Node).\n\n## Environment configuration\n\n### Backend\n\n```bash\ncd backend\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nEdit `backend/.env`. At minimum, set a real contact email in `SEC_USER_AGENT` before making live SEC requests (SEC fair-access policy). See [`backend/.env.example`](backend/.env.example) and [`backend/README.md`](backend/README.md) for every variable.\n\n### Frontend\n\n```bash\ncd frontend\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nDefault:\n\n```env\nVITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000\n```\n\n## Running the project\n\nUse two terminals.\n\n**Terminal 1 — backend**\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run start:dev\n```\n\n**Terminal 2 — frontend**\n\n```bash\ncd frontend\nnpm run dev\n```\n\nCORS is configured for the Vite origin (`http://localhost:5173`).\n\n## Build\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run build\nnpm run start:prod\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run preview\n```\n\n## Testing\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm test\nnpm run test:e2e\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm test\n```\n\n## Linting\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run lint\nnpm run format\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm run lint\n```\n\nThe frontend has an ESLint script only (no Prettier format script).\n\n## Local URLs\n\n| Service | URL |\n| --- | --- |\n| Frontend | http://localhost:5173 |\n| Backend | http://localhost:3000 |\n| Health check | http://localhost:3000/health |\n| API (example) | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/AAPL |\n| Filings (example) | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/AAPL/filings |\n| Swagger UI | http://localhost:3000/docs |\n| OpenAPI JSON | http://localhost:3000/docs-json |\n\n## API documentation\n\nWith the backend running, open **Swagger UI** at [http://localhost:3000/docs](http://localhost:3000/docs).\n\nYou can try company and filings endpoints there. The machine-readable OpenAPI document is at `/docs-json`.\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/backend/README.md",
  "content": "# Backend (NestJS API)\n\nNestJS API that serves company and filing data for the SEC EDGAR filings explorer. This service is the only place that talks to SEC. The frontend must call this API—not SEC directly.\n\nSupported tickers: `AAPL`, `META`, `GOOGL`, `AMZN`, `NFLX`, `GS`.\n\n## Tech stack\n\n- NestJS 11 + TypeScript\n- `@nestjs/config` for environment variables\n- Axios for outbound SEC HTTP (scoped to the SEC client)\n- `class-validator` / `class-transformer` for request validation\n- `@nestjs/swagger` for OpenAPI / Swagger UI\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm install\n```\n\n## Environment configuration\n\n```bash\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nEdit `.env` before starting the server.\n\n| Variable | Required | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `SEC_USER_AGENT` | Yes | Fair-access User-Agent: app name **plus a real contact email** (not a bare URL). Replace the placeholder before live SEC calls. |\n| `SEC_DATA_BASE_URL` | Yes | SEC data API base URL. Must be `https://data.sec.gov` (no trailing slash). |\n| `SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL` | Yes | Base used to build primary document links. Must start with `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data`. |\n| `SEC_TIMEOUT_MS` | Yes | Outbound SEC request timeout in milliseconds (example: `10000`). |\n| `SEC_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS` | Yes | Minimum spacing between SEC requests in milliseconds (example: `100`, about ≤ 10 req/s). |\n| `PORT` | No | HTTP port. Defaults to `3000` if unset. |\n\nExample (from `.env.example`—update the email):\n\n```env\nSEC_USER_AGENT=SEC Filings API your-email@example.com\nSEC_DATA_BASE_URL=https://data.sec.gov\nSEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data\nSEC_TIMEOUT_MS=10000\nSEC_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS=100\n```\n\n## Running locally\n\n```bash\nnpm run start:dev\n```\n\nOther start modes:\n\n```bash\nnpm run start\nnpm run start:debug\n```\n\n## Build\n\n```bash\nnpm run build\nnpm run start:prod\n```\n\n`start:prod` runs the compiled app from `dist/`.\n\n## Testing\n\n```bash\nnpm test\nnpm run test:watch\nnpm run test:cov\nnpm run test:e2e\n```\n\n## Linting and formatting\n\n```bash\nnpm run lint\nnpm run format\n```\n\n`format` runs Prettier on `src/**/*.ts` and `test/**/*.ts`.\n\n## Local URLs\n\n| Endpoint | URL |\n| --- | --- |\n| API base | http://localhost:3000 |\n| Health | http://localhost:3000/health |\n| Company | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/:ticker |\n| Filings | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/:ticker/filings |\n\nFilings query params (optional): `page`, `limit`, `formType`, `startDate`, `endDate` (`YYYY-MM-DD`).\n\nCORS allows the Vite frontend at `http://localhost:5173`.\n\n## API documentation\n\n- Swagger UI: [http://localhost:3000/docs](http://localhost:3000/docs)\n- OpenAPI JSON: [http://localhost:3000/docs-json](http://localhost:3000/docs-json)\n\nStart the backend, then open `/docs` in a browser to explore and try the endpoints.\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/frontend/README.md",
  "content": "# Frontend (React + Vite)\n\nReact UI for the SEC EDGAR filings explorer. Select a supported company ticker, view company details, and browse paginated filings with form-type and date filters.\n\nThe frontend calls **only** the NestJS backend (`VITE_API_BASE_URL`). It never calls SEC EDGAR directly.\n\nSupported tickers: `AAPL`, `META`, `GOOGL`, `AMZN`, `NFLX`, `GS`.\n\n## Tech stack\n\n- React 19 + TypeScript + Vite\n- Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Lucide icons\n- TanStack Query for server state\n- Axios for HTTP (shared client in `src/lib/axios.ts`)\n- React Hook Form + Zod for filings filters\n- React Router (single-page app route)\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\ncd frontend\nnpm install\n```\n\nMake sure the backend is installed and configured as well (see the root and [`backend/README.md`](../backend/README.md)).\n\n## Environment configuration\n\n```bash\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\n| Variable | Required | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `VITE_API_BASE_URL` | Yes | Nest API origin (no `/api` suffix). Local default: `http://localhost:3000`. |\n\nExample:\n\n```env\nVITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000\n```\n\nRestart `npm run dev` after changing env values (Vite reads them at startup).\n\n## Running locally\n\n1. Start the Nest backend on port 3000 (`cd backend && npm run start:dev`).\n2. Start the UI:\n\n```bash\nnpm run dev\n```\n\nOpen http://localhost:5173.\n\n## Build\n\n```bash\nnpm run build\nnpm run preview\n```\n\n`build` type-checks and produces a production bundle in `dist/`. `preview` serves that bundle locally.\n\n## Testing\n\n```bash\nnpm test\nnpm run test:watch\n```\n\nTests use Vitest and Testing Library.\n\n## Linting\n\n```bash\nnpm run lint\n```\n\nThere is no Prettier format script in this package; use ESLint via `npm run lint`.\n\n## Local URLs\n\n| Service | URL |\n| --- | --- |\n| Frontend | http://localhost:5173 |\n| Backend API (dependency) | http://localhost:3000 |\n| Swagger (backend) | http://localhost:3000/docs |\n\n## API documentation\n\nAPI shapes and try-it-out live on the backend Swagger UI: [http://localhost:3000/docs](http://localhost:3000/docs) (backend must be running).\n"
}

filterFilings,\n  mergeByAccession,\n  oldestFilingDate,\n  paginateFilings,\n  sortFilings,\n} from './utils/filings-filter-sort';\nimport { assertDateRange } from './utils/filings-query';\nimport { selectOverlappingHistoricalFiles } from './utils/historical-files';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FilingsService {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly companiesService: CompaniesService,\n    private readonly secClient: SecClient,\n  ) {}\n\n  async list(\n    ticker: string,\n    query: ListFilingsQueryDto,\n  ): Promise<PaginatedFilingsDto> {\n    assertDateRange(query.startDate, query.endDate);\n\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const submissions = await this.secClient.getCompanySubmissions(company.cik);\n\n    let filings = [...submissions.recentFilings];\n    const oldestRecent = oldestFilingDate(filings);\n    const historicalStart = effectiveHistoricalStart(\n      query.startDate,\n      query.endDate,\n    );\n\n    if (\n      historicalStart !== undefined &&\n      (oldestRecent === undefined || historicalStart < oldestRecent)\n    ) {\n      const historical = await this.loadHistoricalFilings(\n        submissions.historicalFiles,\n        historicalStart,\n        query.endDate,\n      );\n      filings = mergeByAccession(filings, historical);\n    }\n\n    const sorted = sortFilings(filterFilings(filings, query));\n    const page = paginateFilings(sorted, query.page, query.limit);\n\n    return {\n      data: page.data.map((filing) => toFilingDto(filing)),\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n      total: page.total,\n      totalPages: page.totalPages,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async findByAccession(\n    ticker: string,\n    accessionNumber: string,\n  ): Promise<FilingDto> {\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const normalizedAccession = accessionNumber.trim();\n    const submissions = await this.secClient.getCompanySubmissions(company.cik);\n\n    const fromRecent = submissions.recentFilings.find(\n      (filing) => filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n    );\n    if (fromRecent) {\n      return toFilingDto(fromRecent);\n    }\n\n    for (const file of submissions.historicalFiles) {\n      const historical = await this.secClient.getSubmissionsFile(file.name);\n      const match = historical.find(\n        (filing) => filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n      );\n      if (match) {\n        return toFilingDto(match);\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new AppError(\n      'not_found',\n      `Filing \"${normalizedAccession}\" was not found for ${company.ticker}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  private async loadHistoricalFilings(\n    files: readonly SecSubmissionsFileRef[],\n    startDate: string,\n    endDate?: string,\n  ): Promise<SecFilingRecord[]> {\n    const overlapping = selectOverlappingHistoricalFiles(\n      files,\n      startDate,\n      endDate,\n    );\n\n    const batches = await Promise.all(\n      overlapping.map((file) => this.secClient.getSubmissionsFile(file.name)),\n    );\n\n    return batches.flat();\n  }\n}\n"

  "content": "import { AppError } from '../../common/errors/app.error';\n\nexport function assertDateRange(startDate?: string, endDate?: string): void {\n  if (startDate && endDate && startDate > endDate) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_request',\n      'startDate must be on or before endDate.',\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Lower bound used when deciding whether to load historical SEC files.\n * No dates → undefined (recent-only). endDate-only → open lower bound.\n */\nexport function effectiveHistoricalStart(\n  startDate?: string,\n  endDate?: string,\n): string | undefined {\n  if (startDate) {\n    return startDate;\n  }\n  if (endDate) {\n    return '0000-01-01';\n  }\n  return undefined;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { AppError } from '../../common/errors/app.error';\nimport type { SecSubmissionsFileRef } from '../../sec/dtos/sec-filing.interface';\n\nconst ACCESSION_NUMBER = /^\\d{10}-\\d{2}-\\d{6}$/;\n\nexport function isValidAccessionNumber(value: string): boolean {\n  return ACCESSION_NUMBER.test(value);\n}\n\nexport function assertAccessionNumber(value: string): string {\n  const normalized = value.trim();\n  if (!isValidAccessionNumber(normalized)) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_request',\n      'accessionNumber must match ##########-##-######.',\n    );\n  }\n  return normalized;\n}\n\n/**\n * Prefer historical files whose range overlaps the accession calendar year\n * (YY from ##########-YY-###### → 20YY). Falls back to all files when none match.\n */\nexport function selectHistoricalFilesForAccession(\n  files: readonly SecSubmissionsFileRef[],\n  accessionNumber: string,\n): SecSubmissionsFileRef[] {\n  const yearToken = accessionNumber.split('-')[1];\n  if (!yearToken || yearToken.length !== 2) {\n    return [...files];\n  }\n\n  const year = 2000 + Number(yearToken);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(year)) {\n    return [...files];\n  }\n\n  const yearStart = `${year}-01-01`;\n  const yearEnd = `${year}-12-31`;\n\n  const overlapping = files.filter((file) => {\n    const filingFrom = file.filingFrom ?? '0000-01-01';\n    const filingTo = file.filingTo ?? '9999-12-31';\n    return filingFrom <= yearEnd && filingTo >= yearStart;\n  });\n\n  return overlapping.length > 0 ? overlapping : [...files];\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { SecFilingRecord } from '../../sec/dtos/sec-filing.interface';\nimport type { ListFilingsQueryDto } from '../dtos/list-filings-query.dto';\n\nexport function oldestFilingDate(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): string | undefined {\n  if (filings.length === 0) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  let oldest = filings[0]?.filingDate;\n  if (!oldest) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  for (const filing of filings) {\n    if (filing.filingDate < oldest) {\n      oldest = filing.filingDate;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return oldest;\n}\n\nexport function mergeByAccession(\n  primary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  secondary: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const byAccession = new Map<string, SecFilingRecord>();\n  // Secondary first, then primary so recent (primary) wins on conflicts.\n  for (const filing of [...secondary, ...primary]) {\n    byAccession.set(filing.accessionNumber, filing);\n  }\n  return [...byAccession.values()];\n}\n\nexport function filterFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  query: Pick<ListFilingsQueryDto, 'formType' | 'startDate' | 'endDate'>,\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  const formType = query.formType?.trim().toUpperCase();\n\n  return filings.filter((filing) => {\n    if (formType && filing.formType.trim().toUpperCase() !== formType) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.startDate && filing.filingDate < query.startDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (query.endDate && filing.filingDate > query.endDate) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    return true;\n  });\n}\n\nexport function sortFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n): SecFilingRecord[] {\n  return [...filings].sort((left, right) => {\n    if (left.filingDate !== right.filingDate) {\n      return right.filingDate.localeCompare(left.filingDate);\n    }\n    return right.accessionNumber.localeCompare(left.accessionNumber);\n  });\n}\n\nexport function paginateFilings(\n  filings: readonly SecFilingRecord[],\n  page: number,\n  limit: number,\n): {\n  data: SecFilingRecord[];\n  total: number;\n  totalPages: number;\n} {\n  const total = filings.length;\n  const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / limit);\n  const start = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n  return {\n    data: filings.slice(start, start + limit),\n    total,\n    totalPages,\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { AppError } from '../../common/errors/app.error';\nimport { normalizeCik, stripLeadingZeros } from './sec-identifiers';\n\nexport function buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n  archivesBaseUrl: string,\n  cik: string,\n  accessionNumber: string,\n  primaryDocument: string,\n): string {\n  const cikForPath = stripLeadingZeros(normalizeCik(cik));\n  const accessionPath = accessionNumber.replace(/-/g, '');\n  const document = primaryDocument.replace(/^\\/+/, '');\n\n  if (!cikForPath || !accessionPath || !document) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_request',\n      'Cannot build SEC document URL from incomplete identifiers.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (\n    document.includes('..') ||\n    document.includes('/') ||\n    document.includes('\\\\')\n  ) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_response',\n      'SEC primary document name contains unsafe path segments.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  return `${archivesBaseUrl}/${cikForPath}/${accessionPath}/${document}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Historical submission files do not always repeat CIK. Derive the numeric\n * CIK prefix from the accession number (CIK-year-sequence).\n */\nexport function buildPrimaryDocumentUrlFromAccession(\n  archivesBaseUrl: string,\n  accessionNumber: string,\n  primaryDocument: string,\n): string {\n  const cikPrefix = accessionNumber.split('-')[0];\n  if (!cikPrefix) {\n    throw new AppError(\n      'bad_response',\n      'SEC accession number is missing a CIK prefix.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  return buildPrimaryDocumentUrl(\n    archivesBaseUrl,\n    cikPrefix,\n    accessionNumber,\n    primaryDocument,\n  );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';\n\nconst TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL = 'https://data.sec.gov';\nconst TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX = 'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data';\n\nexport interface SecConfig {\n  readonly dataBaseUrl: string;\n  readonly archivesBaseUrl: string;\n  readonly timeoutMs: number;\n  readonly minRequestIntervalMs: number;\n  readonly cacheTtlMs: number;\n  readonly userAgent: string;\n}\n\nexport function loadSecConfig(config: ConfigService): SecConfig {\n  const userAgent = requireString(config, 'SEC_USER_AGENT');\n  if (/^https?:\\/\\//i.test(userAgent) || !userAgent.includes('@')) {\n    throw new Error(\n      'SEC_USER_AGENT must be a descriptive app name plus a contact email, not a bare URL.',\n    );\n  }\n\n  const dataBaseUrl = normalizeBaseUrl(\n    requireString(config, 'SEC_DATA_BASE_URL'),\n  );\n  if (dataBaseUrl !== TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `SEC_DATA_BASE_URL must be exactly ${TRUSTED_DATA_BASE_URL}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const archivesBaseUrl = normalizeBaseUrl(\n    requireString(config, 'SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL'),\n  );\n  if (!archivesBaseUrl.startsWith(TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX)) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL must start with ${TRUSTED_ARCHIVES_PREFIX}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  return {\n    userAgent,\n    dataBaseUrl,\n    archivesBaseUrl,\n    timeoutMs: requirePositiveNumber(config, 'SEC_TIMEOUT_MS'),\n    minRequestIntervalMs: requirePositiveNumber(\n      config,\n      'SEC_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS',\n    ),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction requireString(config: ConfigService, key: string): string {\n  const value = config.get<string>(key)?.trim() ?? '';\n  if (!value) {\n    throw new Error(`${key} is required.`);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\nfunction requirePositiveNumber(config: ConfigService, key: string): number {\n  const raw = requireString(config, key);\n  const value = Number(raw);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {\n    throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive number.`);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\nfunction normalizeBaseUrl(url: string): string {\n  return url.replace(/\\/+$/, '');\n}\n"
}

SecFilingRecord,\n  SecSubmissionsFileRef,\n} from '../sec/dtos/sec-filing.interface';\nimport { SecClient } from '../sec/sec.client';\nimport { FilingDto } from './dtos/filing.dto';\nimport { ListFilingsQueryDto } from './dtos/list-filings-query.dto';\nimport { PaginatedFilingsDto } from './dtos/paginated-filings.dto';\nimport { toFilingDto } from './mappers/filing.mapper';\nimport {\n  filterFilings,\n  mergeByAccession,\n  oldestFilingDate,\n  paginateFilings,\n  sortFilings,\n} from './utils/filings-filter-sort';\nimport {\n  assertAccessionNumber,\n  selectHistoricalFilesForAccession,\n} from './utils/accession-number';\nimport {\n  assertDateRange,\n  effectiveHistoricalStart,\n} from './utils/filings-query';\nimport { selectOverlappingHistoricalFiles } from './utils/historical-files';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FilingsService {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly companiesService: CompaniesService,\n    private readonly secClient: SecClient,\n  ) {}\n\n  async list(\n    ticker: string,\n    query: ListFilingsQueryDto,\n  ): Promise<PaginatedFilingsDto> {\n    assertDateRange(query.startDate, query.endDate);\n\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const submissions = await this.secClient.getCompanySubmissions(company.cik);\n\n    let filings = [...submissions.recentFilings];\n    const oldestRecent = oldestFilingDate(filings);\n    const historicalStart = effectiveHistoricalStart(\n      query.startDate,\n      query.endDate,\n    );\n\n    if (\n      historicalStart !== undefined &&\n      (oldestRecent === undefined || historicalStart < oldestRecent)\n    ) {\n      const historical = await this.loadHistoricalFilings(\n        submissions.historicalFiles,\n        historicalStart,\n        query.endDate,\n      );\n      filings = mergeByAccession(filings, historical);\n    }\n\n    const sorted = sortFilings(filterFilings(filings, query));\n    const page = paginateFilings(sorted, query.page, query.limit);\n\n    return {\n      data: page.data.map((filing) => toFilingDto(filing)),\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n      total: page.total,\n      totalPages: page.totalPages,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async findByAccession(\n    ticker: string,\n    accessionNumber: string,\n  ): Promise<FilingDto> {\n    const company = this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n    const normalizedAccession = accessionNumber.trim();\n    const submissions = await this.secClient.getCompanySubmissions(company.cik);\n\n    const fromRecent = submissions.recentFilings.find(\n      (filing) => filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n    );\n    if (fromRecent) {\n      return toFilingDto(fromRecent);\n    }\n\n    for (const file of submissions.historicalFiles) {\n      const historical = await this.secClient.getSubmissionsFile(file.name);\n      const match = historical.find(\n        (filing) => filing.accessionNumber === normalizedAccession,\n      );\n      if (match) {\n        return toFilingDto(match);\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new AppError(\n      'not_found',\n      `Filing \"${normalizedAccession}\" was not found for ${company.ticker}.`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  private async loadHistoricalFilings(\n    files: readonly SecSubmissionsFileRef[],\n    startDate: string,\n    endDate?: string,\n  ): Promise<SecFilingRecord[]> {\n    const overlapping = selectOverlappingHistoricalFiles(\n      files,\n      startDate,\n      endDate,\n    );\n\n    const batches = await Promise.all(\n      overlapping.map((file) => this.secClient.getSubmissionsFile(file.name)),\n    );\n\n    return batches.flat();\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { AppError } from '../common/errors/app.error';\nimport { CompanyDto } from './dtos/company.dto';\nimport {\n  findSupportedCompany,\n  SUPPORTED_COMPANIES,\n} from './supported-companies';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CompaniesService {\n  findAll(): CompanyDto[] {\n    return SUPPORTED_COMPANIES.map((company) => ({\n      ticker: company.ticker,\n      name: company.name,\n      cik: company.cik,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  findByTicker(ticker: string): CompanyDto {\n    const company = findSupportedCompany(ticker);\n    if (!company) {\n      throw new AppError(\n        'not_found',\n        `Company with ticker \"${ticker.trim().toUpperCase()}\" is not supported.`,\n      );\n    }\n\n    return {\n      ticker: company.ticker,\n      name: company.name,\n      cik: company.cik,\n    };\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { Controller, Get, Param } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ApiOkResponse, ApiOperation, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';\nimport { CompaniesService } from './companies.service';\nimport { CompanyDto } from './dtos/company.dto';\n\n@ApiTags('companies')\n@Controller('companies')\nexport class CompaniesController {\n  constructor(private readonly companiesService: CompaniesService) {}\n\n  @Get()\n  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'List supported companies' })\n  @ApiOkResponse({ type: CompanyDto, isArray: true })\n  findAll(): CompanyDto[] {\n    return this.companiesService.findAll();\n  }\n\n  @Get(':ticker')\n  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Look up a supported company by ticker' })\n  @ApiOkResponse({ type: CompanyDto })\n  findByTicker(@Param('ticker') ticker: string): CompanyDto {\n    return this.companiesService.findByTicker(ticker);\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/backend/src/configure-app.ts",
  "content": "import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from '@nestjs/swagger';\nimport { AppExceptionFilter } from './common/filters/app-exception.filter';\n\nconst DEFAULT_CORS_ORIGINS = ['http://localhost:5173'];\n\nexport function resolveCorsOrigins(\n  raw: string | undefined = process.env.CORS_ORIGINS,\n): string[] {\n  if (!raw?.trim()) {\n    return [...DEFAULT_CORS_ORIGINS];\n  }\n\n  const origins = raw\n    .split(',')\n    .map((origin) => origin.trim())\n    .filter(Boolean);\n\n  return origins.length > 0 ? origins : [...DEFAULT_CORS_ORIGINS];\n}\n\nexport function configureApp(app: INestApplication): void {\n  app.setGlobalPrefix('api', {\n    exclude: ['health'],\n  });\n  app.enableCors({\n    origin: resolveCorsOrigins(),\n  });\n  app.useGlobalPipes(\n    new ValidationPipe({\n      transform: true,\n      whitelist: true,\n      forbidNonWhitelisted: true,\n      transformOptions: {\n        enableImplicitConversion: true,\n        exposeDefaultValues: true,\n      },\n    }),\n  );\n  app.useGlobalFilters(new AppExceptionFilter());\n\n  const config = new DocumentBuilder()\n    .setTitle('SEC EDGAR filings')\n    .setDescription('Read-only filings API for the supported tickers.')\n    .setVersion('1.0')\n    .build();\n\n  SwaggerModule.setup('docs', app, () =>\n    SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config),\n  );\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/backend/README.md",
  "content": "# Backend (NestJS API)\n\nNestJS API that serves company and filing data for the SEC EDGAR filings explorer. This service is the only place that talks to SEC. The frontend must call this API—not SEC directly.\n\nSupported tickers: `AAPL`, `META`, `GOOGL`, `AMZN`, `NFLX`, `GS`.\n\n## Tech stack\n\n- NestJS 11 + TypeScript\n- `@nestjs/config` for environment variables\n- Axios for outbound SEC HTTP (scoped to the SEC client)\n- `class-validator` / `class-transformer` for request validation\n- `@nestjs/swagger` for OpenAPI / Swagger UI\n\n## Installation\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm install\n```\n\n## Environment configuration\n\n```bash\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nEdit `.env`. At minimum, set a real contact email in `SEC_USER_AGENT` before making live SEC requests (SEC fair-access policy). See [`.env.example`](.env.example) and [`README.md`](README.md) for every variable.\n\n| Variable                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                     |\n| ----------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| `SEC_USER_AGENT`              | Yes      | Fair-access User-Agent: app name **plus a real contact email** (not a bare URL). Replace the placeholder before live SEC calls. |\n| `SEC_DATA_BASE_URL`           | Yes      | SEC data API base URL. Must be `https://data.sec.gov` (no trailing slash).                                                      |\n| `SEC_ARCHIVES_BASE_URL`       | Yes      | Base used to build primary document links. Must start with `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data`.                           |\n| `SEC_TIMEOUT_MS`              | Yes      | Outbound SEC request timeout in milliseconds (example: `10000`).                                                                |\n| `SEC_MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS` | Yes      | Minimum spacing between SEC requests in milliseconds (example: `100`, about ≤ 10 req/s).                                        |\n| `SEC_CACHE_TTL_MS`            | No       | In-memory SEC response cache TTL in milliseconds. {
  "file_path": "/Users/drive1/projects/interview/quartr/public-api/README.md",
  "content": "# SEC EDGAR Filings Explorer\n\nRead-only app for browsing SEC EDGAR filings for six supported companies: **AAPL**, **META**, **GOOGL**, **AMZN**, **NFLX**, and **GS**.\n\nThe React frontend talks only to the NestJS backend. The backend is the only service that calls SEC EDGAR.\n\nMore detail:\n\n- Backend: [`backend/README.md`](backend/README.md)\n- Frontend: [`frontend/README.md`](frontend/README.md)\n\n## Tech stack\n\n| Layer    | Technologies                                                                                                           |\n| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Backend  | NestJS 11, TypeScript, `@nestjs/config`, Axios (SEC client), class-validator, Swagger                                  |\n| Frontend | React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Axios, React Hook Form, Zod, React Router, Lucide |\n\n## Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository.\n2. Install dependencies for each app (there is no root `package.json`):\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm install\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm install\n```\n\nUse a current Node.js LTS release (or compatible modern Node).\n\n## Environment configuration\n\n### Backend\n\n```bash\ncd backend\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nEdit `backend/.env`. At minimum, set a real contact email in `SEC_USER_AGENT` before making live SEC requests (SEC fair-access policy). See [`backend/.env.example`](backend/.env.example) and [`backend/README.md`](backend/README.md) for every variable.\n\n### Frontend\n\n```bash\ncd frontend\ncp .env.example .env\n```\n\nDefault:\n\n```env\nVITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000\n```\n\n## Running the project\n\nUse two terminals.\n\n**Terminal 1 — backend**\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run start:dev\n```\n\n**Terminal 2 — frontend**\n\n```bash\ncd frontend\nnpm run dev\n```\n\nCORS is configured for the Vite origin (`http://localhost:5173`).\n\n## Build\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run build\nnpm run start:prod\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm run build\nnpm run preview\n```\n\n## Testing\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm test\nnpm run test:e2e\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm test\n```\n\n## Linting\n\n```bash\ncd backend\nnpm run lint\nnpm run format\n\ncd ../frontend\nnpm run lint\n```\n\nThe frontend has an ESLint script only (no Prettier format script).\n\n## Local URLs\n\n| Service           | URL                                              |\n| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |\n| Frontend          | http://localhost:5173                            |\n| Backend           | http://localhost:3000                            |\n| Health check      | http://localhost:3000/health                     |\n| Companies list    | http://localhost:3000/api/companies              |\n| API (example)     | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/AAPL         |\n| Filings (example) | http://localhost:3000/api/companies/AAPL/filings |\n| Swagger UI        | http://localhost:3000/docs                       |\n| OpenAPI JSON      | http://localhost:3000/docs-json                  |\n\nFilings date filters are inclusive on **filing date**. With no dates, results are recent SEC submissions only; historical files load when the requested range can fall outside that window. See [`backend/README.md`](backend/README.md) for query defaults and accession lookup.\n\n## API documentation\n\nWith the backend running, open **Swagger UI** at [http://localhost:3000/docs](http://localhost:3000/docs).\n\nYou can try company and filings endpoints there. The machine-readable OpenAPI document is at `/docs-json`.\n"
}

  "content": "import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\nimport { getFilings } from '../services/filingsService'\nimport {\n  emptyFilingsFilters,\n  toFilingsQuery,\n  type FilingsFiltersFormValues,\n} from '../types/filing.types'\n\nexport function useFilings(ticker: string) {\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)\n  const [filters, setFilters] =\n    useState<FilingsFiltersFormValues>(emptyFilingsFilters)\n\n  const query = toFilingsQuery(page, filters)\n\n  const filingsQuery = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['filings', ticker, query],\n    queryFn: ({ signal }) => getFilings(ticker, query, signal),\n    enabled: Boolean(ticker),\n  })\n\n  const applyFilters = useCallback((next: FilingsFiltersFormValues) => {\n    setFilters(next)\n    setPage(1)\n  }, [])\n\n  const resetForTicker = useCallback(() => {\n    setFilters(emptyFilingsFilters)\n    setPage(1)\n  }, [])\n\n  return {\n    ...filingsQuery,\n    page,\n    filters,\n    setPage,\n    applyFilters,\n    resetForTicker,\n  }\n}\n"
}
